summaries.text: Fair Minimum Wage Act of 1999 - Amends the Fair Labor Standards Act of 1938 to increase the Federal minimum wage (currently $5.15 per hour) to: (1) $5.65 an hour during the year beginning on January 1, 2000; and (2) $6.15 an hour beginning on January 1, 2001.Makes Federal minimum wage requirements applicable to the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands.
